items.title: CISA警示FortiMail漏洞CVE-2026-104286已遭實際利用
items.summary: 美國網路與基礎設施安全局（CISA）維護的已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV），10月1日新增CVE-2026-104286，這是存在Fortinet郵件安全閘道設備FortiMail的路徑遍歷漏洞，聯邦政府各民事執行單位須在10月4日前完成修補。

items.title: Chrome 154本週第二度發布更新版，緊急修補11個漏洞
items.summary: 9月29日Google發布Chrome瀏覽器的154.0.8037.92版或154.0.8037.93版，修補32個漏洞，兩天後又緊急推出更新版本，目前針對Windows平臺與Mac平臺的Chrome提供154.0.8037.97版或154.0.8037.98版，針對Android平臺的Chrome提供154.0.8037.126版，至於Linux平臺的Chrome，則是預計在後續幾天或幾週推出154.0.8037.97版，當中總共修補11個漏洞。

items.title: fix: Gateway stalls while background skill reviews or rooted cron job…
items.summary: fix: Gateway stalls while background skill reviews or rooted cron jobs start (#164049) * fix(agents): reuse the agent plugin generation for rooted background runs Rooted runs (skill workshop reviews in auto mode, cron jobs with an execution root) passed the execution root as workspaceDir, which also keyed the prepared model runtime and plugin metadata. No configured generation matched, so each run cold-built its own generation and cold-loaded tool plugins synchronously on the Gateway main thread (observed: 99 s prepared-runtime + 51 s plugin-tools, dropping websockets and a chat.send). When bootstrapWorkspaceDir resolves to the agent's canonical workspace, select the prepared runtime with that workspace and keep the run bound to its execution root. Compaction follows the same selection. Non-canonical or absent bootstrap workspaces keep their own generation. * test(agents): run the rooted prepared-runtime regression in the database worker lane

items.title: fix(webhooks): preserve callbacks while retiring implicit ports (#162…
items.summary: fix(webhooks): preserve callbacks while retiring implicit ports (#162759) Retire implicit channel webhook ports for new installations and preserve existing callback endpoints with one-shot Doctor pins through the existing config backup and include writer. Register Telegram replacement webhooks before releasing old listeners, preserve proxy URLs, and require host/plugin API >=2026.9.9 for Telegram, Feishu, Microsoft Teams, and Nextcloud Talk standalone plugins. OpenClaw 2026.9.9 must ship the listener-pin migration. Validated with the actual published 2026.9.7 updater, signed four-channel Gateway callbacks, permanent pin removal, fresh installs, and actual published 2026.9.8 rejection of all four new packages without replacing running plugins. See the PR for source identities, measured costs, and qualified prior proof.
